A standalone checker cross-compares quadratures and simulation; finite checks do not replace proof.

The theorem fully determines a familywide strict dichotomy between two angular levels, with a counterintuitive reversal in total versus per-vertex exposure, in a family containing the recently classified nine-vertex four-volume maximizer.
